Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 25 Oct 2004 15:06:32 -0700, ebo...@hotmail.com (Emile Bosman)
wrote:

>does the blood moved to Vitae Block counts as blood loss during
>combat?

Yes and no.
The blood is lost.
It is not lost to damage.

>So if Matthias plays a Vitae Block and an Anesthetic Touch he can
>taste back 4 blood?

Nope.

Vitae Block does not do damage.
Blood lost for non-damage reasons cannot be acquired via Taste of
Vitae.

Pertinent card text on Taste of Vitae:

"lost by the opposing vampire to damage"

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist.html

http://monger.vekn.org/showcard.html?ID=780

Taste of Vitae [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, SW:PB, CE:U/PB2/PN, BH:PN2]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable at the end of a round of combat. Not usable by a vampire
going into torpor.
This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the
opposing vampire to damage during this round of combat. A vampire can
play only 1 Taste of Vitae each round.

Carpe noctem.

> does the blood moved to Vitae Block counts as blood loss during

Cards text for taste is;

Only usable at the end of a round of combat. Not usable by a vampire
going into torpor.
This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the
opposing vampire to damage during this round of combat. A vampire can
play only 1 Taste of Vitae each round.

Card text for Vitae Block is:
Play before range is determined. Only usable if the opposing minion is
a vampire. A vampire can play only one Vitae Block each combat.
[ani] Gain 1 optional press this round.
[obe] Put this card in play, and move up to 2 blood from the opposing
vampire to this card. During your untap phase, return the blood
counters to that vampire and burn this card.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but <move> up to 3 blood to this card.

I do not believe that vitaw block does any damage at all.. so you can
not taste blood loss dur to vitaw block.
